text:
Clenched hands confine me to exile.
+
+Help me not to ask for help.
+
+They want to nightfall me, they are going to die me.
+
+Help me not to ask for help.

translation.title: Figures and Silences
translation.editorial_note: Pizarnik’s transitive anochecer and morir are recreated as nightfall me and die me; grammatical violence enacts the threatened violence against the speaker.
